note: Preserved CLI, native public events and local checks. Interrupted attempts retain unknown exit and linked recovery evidence, never fabricated success. Prelaunch failures have actual wrapper exit and null product exit; child streams/results were never created. Nonzero includes expected safety refusals, auxiliary mistakes and environment failures; classification is in handoffs/controller records. Root orchestration errors outside captured streams are documented separately, not claimed exhaustively reconstructed.
